names.note: Read out of the title on the name link behind his place in days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 24 октября ст. ст., «Николай (Никольский), иерей, сщмч.», with the rank words left off. The line itself declines the name and gives it without the surname, as «Сщмчч. ... и Николая пресвитеров».

feast.note: His name page heads «Дни памяти: 26 января (Новомуч.) , 24 октября», the January day being the synaxis of the new martyrs and confessors of Russia. One row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he does not render on it.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 октября ст. ст. — «Сщмчч. Иоанна и Николая пресвитеров (1937).»

attestations.note: He is the second of two and the name «пресвитеров» stands after, which is what fixes the grade of the first as well as his own; the link behind his place says иерей, the same thing. The corpus holds seven other men of this surname and none of this forename, so no reading is needed to tell him from any of them. The calendar carries no life for him.

death.note: The year days.pravoslavie.ru prints at the end of the line it names him in on 24 октября ст. ст. The calendar carries no life page for him and gives no day.
